listing.name: Lufia & the Fortress of Doom — Estpolis Recompendium (dothacktranslate)
listing.summary: Experimental Lufia 1 source port using your exact USA ROM. Upstream reports working video, input and audio, with post-battle text flicker and stability still being tested. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Lufia 1 ROM: 1048576 bytes, SHA-256 73731a5a7932965de02a9e98055dcf88b4d17b8f710a6ecfde3e36a1f248773b. Japanese editions and Lufia II are planned and are not supported.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build from source with CMake and SDL2 using upstream’s instructions. Keep your own ROM available while the game runs.

warnings: Upstream reports working video, input and audio for Lufia 1. Gameplay stability needs more testing, and text flickers after battles.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
